canonical_api.output_contract: out_maze is reset to NULL before validation and receives caller ownership only on success

algorithm.lattice: odd-coordinate logical cells with a blocked one-cell perimeter
algorithm.frontier: explicit wall and target coordinates in an indexed swap-pop bag
algorithm.inventory: each unique logical-grid edge is popped exactly once
algorithm.selection: uniform bounded selection over the current frontier
algorithm.rng: shared Maze PCG32 generation context; Stage 1 draw order and raster hashes are preserved
algorithm.claim_boundary: randomized frontier growth; no minimum-weight or uniform-spanning-tree guarantee

validation.dimensions: width and height are odd and at least 3
validation.bounds: the inclusive last coordinate and each dimension must fit int32_t
validation.max_steps: one step per frontier pop; default is raster cells times 16
validation.edge_count: E must fit the bounded RNG uint32_t domain
validation.cancellation: polled before generation, at every frontier pop, and throughout raster materialization
validation.exception_barrier: bad_alloc maps to OUT_OF_MEMORY; callback exceptions map to CALLBACK_FAILED; other exceptions map to CORRUPT_STATE
validation.failure_atomicity: partial Maze output is never published

compatibility.legacy_policy: deprecated ABI 1.x typo adapter forwarding to the checked generator
compatibility.generic_dispatcher: BYUL_MAZE_ALGORITHM_RANDOMIZED_PRIM produces the same raster for equal options

wrapper.policy_tests: 11/11 maze wrapper policy tests passed against the current MSVC Release DLL
wrapper.generation_check: generated CFFI declarations are up to date

verification.sdk_consumer: clean-install C17 and C++17 consumers built and ran successfully
verification.standalone_header: clean-install MSVC C17 and C++17 probes passed
verification.strict_header_audit: 150 headers, 95 public C headers, 1171 declarations, 0 invariant errors
